name: impulse fade — RSI exhaustion at a lower high
origin: narrated from a live GTLB trade, 2026-09-02

rule.exhaustion: RSI(14) >= 75 on an up-impulse, <= 25 on a down-impulse
rule.structure: the post-impulse swing must NOT exceed the impulse extreme (a lower high)
rule.entry: first bar closing against the impulse; ENTER AT THAT CLOSE, never at the extreme
rule.stop: the swing extreme, floored at 1.0 * ATR14

thresholds_provenance: RSI 75/25 are the p90/p10 of RSI at 73,255 impulse moments — read off the indicator's own distribution, never from returns
